631973.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Gotcha!] Whenever this character quests, Jafar steals The Reforged Crown.

631974.Flavor Text:
“I’m sure you’ll figure it out in a thousand years or so.”
– Jafar

634262.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Bolt.)
[Mark of Power] Whenever you ready this character, gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you have in play.
[Bolt Stare] [Exert] — Banish chosen Illusion character.

634263.Description: [Plenty To Go Around] At the end of your turn, you may remove up to 1 damage from each of your other characters. Ready each character you removed damage from this way.
634263.Flavor Text: “You’re just in time for the Surprise à la Goof!”

634264.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Got To Keep Real Quiet] Once during your turn, whenever you ready this character, you may draw a card.

634265.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Elsa.)
[Winter Wall] Whenever this character quests, you may exert chosen character. If you do, and you have a character named Anna in play, the chosen character can't ready at the start of their next turn.

634271.Flavor Text: "Don't get overconfident. They won't all be this easy."

634273.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Simultaneous Strike] When Jafar plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their characters, one of their items, and one of their locations.

634279.Description: [Bring It To Me] When Jafar plays this character, he steals The Reforged Crown.
634279.Flavor Text: “Ah, yes. I’ll be taking that.” – Jafar

634283.Description:
Ward (Illumineers can't choose this location except to challenge)
[No Escape] When Jafar plays this location, he deals 2 damage to each opposing character.

634284.Description:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of Jafar’s characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Jafar's Sentry] This character enters play exerted.
[Sound The Alarm] While this character is exerted, Jafar’s locations can’t be challenged.

634286.Description:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of Jafar’s characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Jafar's Sentry] This character enters play exerted.

634288.Description: [Shifting Sands] Illumineers can't use battleground abilities.
634288.Flavor Text: “Oh dear, have the rules changed? How dreadfully sad… for you.” – Jafar

634293.Description: [Return To Me!] When Jafar plays this character, he plays all items named Mechanical Snake from his discard for free.
634293.Flavor Text: “You didn’t think this was over, did you? Bow before true power!”

634294.Description: [Perfect Timing] When Jafar plays this character, if each Illumineer has an exerted character in play, he gains 3 lore.
634294.Flavor Text: “Behold the power of my sorcery. This genie is mine!” – Jafar

634295.Description: [Pay Fealty] When Jafar plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and discards a card.

634297.Description: [Over Here!] Whenever this character quests, Jafar draws a card.
634297.Flavor Text: “This version may be less substantial than the real princess, but she’ll do.”– Jafar

634299.Description: [Fighting Dirty] When Jafar plays this character, he deals 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.
634299.Flavor Text: “What he lacks in manners he makes up in sheer cruelty.” – Jafar

634304.Description: [Secret Vulnerability] During the Illumineers' turn, they pay pay 3 Lore each to banish this character.
634304.Flavor Text: “Just the thing to deal with pests like you!" – Jafar

634306.Description: [Serpent's Shadow] When Jafar plays this character, he deals 3 damage to each opposing exerted character.
634306.Flavor Text: “Behold the wonders of true power! Even the stone is mine to command!” – Jafar

634308.Description: [Dreadful Stare] This character can’t be challenged by damaged characters.
634308.Flavor Text: “The palace guardians don’t take kindly to interlopers. Consider yourself warned.” – Jafar

634400.Description: [Face the Flames] At the start of Jafar’s turn, he banishes this item to have each Illumineer choose one of their characters and deal 4 damage to them.

634405.Description: [Snakebite] When Jafar plays this location, he deals 1 damage to each opposing character.

634407.Flavor Text: “Why, yes, he is annoying. So kind of you to notice. I wanted this illusion to be as accurate as possible.” – Jafar

634411.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
634411.Flavor Text: “The best part about this illusion? He knows his place.” – Jafar

634414.Flavor Text: “I’ll admit, he has a great mind–for a mouse.” – Jafar

634417.Description: [Map The Maze] Whenever a character challenges this location, each Illumineer chooses and discards a card.

634421.Description: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this location is reduced by 1.)

634426.Description:
[Seize the Crown!] When Jafar plays this item, he steals The Reforged Crown.
[Disassembled Serpent] Exert, Banish this item – Jafar gains 2 lore.

634427.Description: [Vertigo] When Jafar plays this location, he deals 3 damage to the character with the highest cost each Illumineer has in play. (If there’s a tie, the Illumineers choose from the tied characters.)

634429.Description: [Vertigo] Exert – Jafar deals 1 damage to each opposing character
634429.Flavor Text: It’s important to make time for friends.” – Jafar

634432.Description: Jafar deals 1 damage to each opposing character. Then, put this card into his inkwell facedown.
634432.Flavor Text: “Things are getting a bit rough, aren’t they?” – Jafar

634433.Description:
Jafar’s locations lose Ward until the start of his next turn.
The Illumineers may choose and banish up to one of Jafar’s locations.

634434.Description: Jafar returns all opposing exerted characters to their Illumineers’ hands.

634435.Description: Jafar gains 2 lore. Then, put this card into his inkwell facedown.
634435.Flavor Text: “Yes! I can feel it! All of Lorcana shall tremble before me!”

634437.Description: Each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their items or locations.
634437.Flavor Text: “You’ll have to dig deep if you want that back!” – Jafar

634439.Description: Each Illumineer chooses one of their characters, items, or locations. Then, Jafar banishes all other opposing characters, items, and locations.

634444.Description: Jafar exerts all opposing characters. They can’t ready at the start of their next turn.
634444.Flavor Text:
“Your plan’s beginning to crumble. Try not to lose your grip!”
–Jafar

634446.Description: Ward (Illumineers can’t choose this location except to challenge.)
634446.Flavor Text: “Magical crystal to secure my most powerful treasures.” – Jafar

639461.Description:
At the end of their turn, whoever has this item gains 2 lore.
If this item would leave play for any reason, Jafar steals it instead.
When Jafar has this item, he can't lose the game.

639901.Description:
Difficulty: Easy
Jafar's characters enter play exerted.
Illumineer Abilities
Lore Cost — Effect
1 — Chosen Character gets Resist +1 until end of turn.
2 — Another chosen Illumineer gains 2 lore.
3 — Deal 5 damage to the chosen character or location

Secret Passage
Difficulty: Normal
Jafar starts the game with Ink Moat in play.
Illumineer Abilities
Lore Cost — Effect
1 — Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
2 — Chosen Illumineer draws a card.
3 — Deal 5 damage to chosen location.

639904.Description:
Difficulty: Hard
Jafar begins the game with Ink Moat in play.
Jafar's locations gain Resist +1.
Illumineer Abilities
Lore Cost — Effect
1 — Chosen Character gets +2 Strength this turn.
2 — Each Illumineer pays 1 ink less for the next character they play this turn.
3 — Each Illumineer puts the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.

Full Alert
Difficulty: Extreme
Jafar starts the game with Ink Moat in play.
Jafar's locations gain Evasive and get +1 Lore.
Illumineer Abilities
Lore Cost — Effect
4 — Chosen character gains Evasive this turn.
